meta.title: Qwen image generation
meta.description: Adds the qwen_image_generate tool, which draws images with the Qwen Token Plan image models (qwen-image-3.0-pro, wan2.7-image and others) and saves them into the session workspace. The API key is read from the QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY credential; generation sends the prompt to the Qwen Token Plan endpoint and counts against that plan. Turning the plugin off removes the tool.
